name: Web Plura Social Draft Planner
author: Web Plura

sections.description:
Social media planning gets messy when WordPress posts, WooCommerce products, captions, hashtags, UTM links, first-comment notes, campaign dates, and review tasks live in separate documents.

Web Plura Social Draft Planner helps WordPress admins turn site content into local social media drafts before anything is posted. Create captions, organize campaign notes, plan calendar dates, review copy, preview link details, export draft content, and open manual Share It links from wp-admin.

Drafts can start from WordPress posts, pages, WooCommerce products, public custom post types, public URLs, RSS items, or manual topics. The plugin can use local source details such as title, excerpt, permalink, categories, tags, author, featured image, site name, product price, and SKU when available.

WordPress Social Media Planning Features

Social media workflow problems it helps with

Use the free plugin when you need a local WordPress social media content calendar for:

  • Drafting social captions from posts, pages, WooCommerce products, public custom post types, URLs, RSS items, or manual ideas.
  • Keeping campaign, platform, status, planned time, review owner, due date, and review notes beside each draft.
  • Preparing hashtags, first-comment/manual follow-up text, UTM presets, and link previews before sharing.
  • Reviewing Open Graph and X Card readiness using local WordPress URL metadata.
  • Exporting approved draft content to CSV or JSON for manual posting, client review, or a separate scheduling tool.
  • Opening manual Share It links without storing social OAuth tokens or auto-publishing from WordPress.

Included local features:

  • Social caption drafts for WordPress content, WooCommerce products, public URLs, RSS items, and manual ideas.
  • Content calendar planning with platform, campaign, status, planned time, and manual reshare markers.
  • Review fields for task owner, due date, status, and notes.
  • Templates with source variables, reusable hashtag groups, taxonomy hashtag help, and UTM/link presets.
  • Local previews with link, media, hashtag, Open Graph, and X Card readiness checks.
  • First-comment or manual follow-up text stored with each draft.
  • Manual Share It links for supported social platforms and email.
  • CSV and JSON exports for reviewed draft content.
  • Optional local AI prompt preview and setup validation for loopback or self-hosted endpoints.

The plugin does not publish, schedule, connect social OAuth accounts, or send content to Web Plura Cloud. Users manually share or export reviewed content.

Good Fit For

  • WordPress site owners and bloggers planning social captions from existing posts and pages.
  • WooCommerce marketers preparing product posts without automatic publishing.
  • Agencies and content teams organizing campaigns, review tasks, hashtags, UTM links, and exports locally.
  • Administrators who want optional loopback or self-hosted AI prompt previews without hosted Web Plura AI.

External Services

This plugin contacts external URLs only when an administrator uses one of the features below. It does not send local drafts, exports, AI prompts, or Share It data to Web Plura Cloud.

Local AI endpoints: If an administrator enables local AI and clicks preview, test, or generate, WordPress sends the approved prompt, selected source text, brand/context settings, content type, platform, and model name to the configured endpoint. Supported presets are Ollama (http://127.0.0.1:11434), LM Studio (http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1/chat/completions), llama.cpp (http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions), and administrator-entered loopback OpenAI-compatible endpoints. The endpoint returns generated draft text or an error. Hosted Web Plura AI is not included in this free plugin. Ollama terms: https://ollama.com/terms and privacy: https://ollama.com/privacy. LM Studio terms: https://lmstudio.ai/app-terms and privacy: https://lmstudio.ai/app-privacy. llama.cpp license: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/LICENSE. Custom endpoint terms and privacy are controlled by the endpoint owner.

Public URL and RSS imports: If an administrator imports a public URL or RSS feed, WordPress fetches that entered URL to read metadata such as title, description, image URL, feed item link, and excerpt. The destination is the website or feed entered by the administrator. Private, local, and internal network URLs are blocked. Terms and privacy depend on that entered website or feed.

Manual Share It links: If an administrator opens a Share It link, the browser opens the selected platform or email client with supported draft values in the URL. Depending on the provider, values can include source URL, caption text, hashtags, public media URL, email subject, or email body. Facebook opens https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php, X/Twitter opens https://twitter.com/intent/tweet, LinkedIn opens https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/, Pinterest opens https://www.pinterest.com/pin/create/button/, Telegram opens https://t.me/share/url, WhatsApp opens https://api.whatsapp.com/send, Instagram opens https://www.instagram.com/, TikTok opens https://www.tiktok.com/upload, and email uses a mailto: link. Instagram and TikTok are manual copy/post flows. The plugin does not store social OAuth tokens and does not automatically publish. Facebook terms: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms and Meta privacy: https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy. X terms: https://x.com/en/tos and privacy: https://x.com/en/privacy. LinkedIn terms: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/user-agreement and privacy: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/privacy-policy. Pinterest terms: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/terms-of-service and privacy: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/privacy-policy. Telegram terms: https://telegram.org/tos and privacy: https://telegram.org/privacy. WhatsApp legal: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/. Instagram terms: https://help.instagram.com/581066165581870 and Meta privacy: https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy. TikTok terms: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/us/terms-of-service/en and privacy: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/us/privacy-policy/en.

Web Plura links: If an administrator clicks product, pricing, terms, or privacy links, the browser opens Web Plura pages. These links send a normal browser request to Web Plura, but the plugin does not send local drafts, exports, AI prompts, imported source content, or Share It data to Web Plura. Product: https://wplura.com/products/web-plura-social-draft-planner. Pricing: https://wplura.com/pricing/. Terms: https://wplura.com/terms. Privacy: https://wplura.com/privacy.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Web Plura Social Draft Planner.
  3. Open the plugin dashboard from the WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an external account?

No. Local drafts, non-AI templates, previews, reviews, Share It links, and exports work without an external account.

Does the free plugin include hosted AI?

No. Free AI settings are for local loopback or self-hosted model endpoints only. Hosted Web Plura AI is not part of this free plugin.

Does the plugin store social OAuth tokens locally?

No. This free package does not connect social OAuth accounts or store long-term social OAuth tokens.

Does the plugin copy external article content?

No. External import is metadata-oriented and shows source/copyright warnings.

Is this a WordPress social media content calendar plugin?

Yes. It provides local draft planning, campaign fields, platform/status filters, planned times, review notes, manual reshare markers, and export tools.

Can I use it before a social media scheduler or Buffer-style tool?

Yes. You can draft, review, copy, and export social content locally, then manually paste or import the reviewed content into another approved publishing workflow.

Does it automatically publish or schedule social posts?

No. The free plugin creates local drafts, previews, exports, and manual Share It links. It does not connect social OAuth accounts or publish automatically.

Can it prepare WooCommerce product social posts?

Yes. When WooCommerce product data is available, drafts can use local product details such as title, excerpt, permalink, featured image, price, and SKU.

Will Share It links post to Instagram or TikTok automatically?

No. Instagram and TikTok are manual copy/post flows in the free plugin. The plugin helps prepare the draft but does not publish it for you.
sections.changelog:
0.2.9

  • Refreshed the WordPress.org readme for clearer social media draft, content calendar, WooCommerce social post, Share It, and local planner search intent.

0.2.8

  • Renamed the WordPress.org package slug, text domain, admin slugs, hooks, and assets to Web Plura Social Draft Planner.
  • Added activation migration that copies legacy option keys into the new Social Draft Planner option keys without deleting old data.

0.2.7

  • Updated the WP.org display name to Web Plura Social Draft Planner while keeping the previous slug and text domain.
  • Expanded external service disclosures for local AI endpoints, public URL/RSS imports, Share It links, and Web Plura links.
  • Removed a sibling-directory shared registry load so the free package runs as a standalone WordPress.org plugin.

0.2.6

  • Restored a neutral Upgrade page that compares the local free plugin with separate Pro/cloud services without changing local feature availability.

0.2.5

  • Updated WordPress.org review metadata and preflight-safe admin copy.
  • Tightened read-only request parsing for WP.org preflight scans without changing local drafting behavior.

0.2.4

  • Added a calendar workflow extension surface while keeping the local workflow available in the free plugin.

0.2.3

  • Added a dashboard workflow extension surface with the legacy dashboard card hook as fallback for reversible workflow replacements.

0.2.1

  • Use the canonical direct-access guard for safe uninstall handling.

0.2.0

  • Added reusable local hashtag groups, first-comment/manual follow-up text, evergreen/manual reshare queue markers, and calendar quick actions.
  • Added a local Open Graph/X Card checklist for draft links and media without external page fetches.
  • Added CSV/JSON export and Share It payload coverage for new local planning fields.

0.1.0

  • Initial MVP foundation.
